subject: Correction: the author's privacy remark is about the car; B-f1 withdrawn, S-f1 is the car question, car take 2 held (delta v3)

attachments.description: interview file: B-f1 withdrawn; S provisional with the author's remark and S-f1
card delta v3: B-f1 withdrawn, S-f1 re-worded and ask-first, S provisional

body: Correction to this afternoon's handback (TCM-AUTHOR-ANSWERS-20261101): Ziggy read the author's remark 'what brand can he have that has actual privacy' as being about the car, not the phone, and he is right. B-f1 is withdrawn; S-f1 is now the car question (the model the author named reads as a police car; drive it anyway, or a car that passes as private) and goes to the author first with N and O-f1; the car's identity in Addendum A section 2 is provisional; the fifteen-still car take 2 asked in the Pent House is held until he answers. Delta v3 corrects v2 for the card. Section 5a of the decisions record carries the correction; section 5 stands as written.
